body.rule: Non-compete enforceability check (§ 50-4A-1): On promotion to healthcare practitioner role, system must: (a) Identify if employee subject to non-compete; (b) If yes, flag as unenforceable per § 50-4A-1 (applies to all listed healthcare roles); (c) Document non-solicitation clause (≤1 year) and liquidated damages as enforceable alternatives; (d) On promotion, check if new role changes healthcare-practitioner status and update enforceability status.
